notes:
A deep-fried, panko-breaded pork cutlet (⟦{豚|ぶた}→豚：04710_buta⟧ 'pork' + カツ from English "cutlet"). A staple of casual Japanese dining, usually served with shredded cabbage, rice, and a thick sauce.
